annotations.title: What are the odds this US series crosses a line in the next three months?

description: Use when the user's plan turns on whether rent, food prices, household energy, wages or retail sales will be above or below a level soon: "what are the chances rent inflation is above 3% in December?", "will grocery store sales grow more than 2%?". The operating numbers a plan is built on, not headline CPI. Returns a probability in percent and in words, the central forecast and its 80% range, and the same question answered by "same month last year" and by the historical base rate, so you can see what the model adds. Up to 3 months past the latest published figure only: further out, the method missed by up to 21 points in testing. Refuses before you are charged when the series fails its benchmark today or the month is out of range. Each sold call is scored when the month is published. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For the full 12-month path, use run_series_forecast.

direction.description: Whether you want the odds of being above or below the line. Default above.

month.description: The target month, YYYY-MM, 1 to 3 months after the latest published figure.

series.description: The FRED series ID, e.g. CUUR0000SEHA (rent), CUUR0000SAF11 (food at home), CEU0500000003 (hourly earnings), MRTSSM4451USN (grocery store sales), RSXFSN (retail sales).

yoy_pct.description: The line: year-on-year change in percent, e.g. 3 for 3.0%.
